# Baseline: the same run through plain Git

Every agent's first attempt from the farmstand run, merged with `git merge` in the order they were claimed, as a
queue whose only gate is "it merges" would. Then canon's 9 facts and the agents' claimed facts were run against the merged app.

**5 of 6 attempts merged cleanly. The merged app breaks 1 of canon's 9 facts.**

| Agent | Claimed | git merge |
|---|---|---|
| agent-1 | Buying 10 or more of one item takes 10% off that line | merged cleanly |
| agent-2 | A stall cannot be double-booked | merged cleanly |
| agent-5 | Shoppers can search products by name | merged cleanly |
| agent-3 | Two vendors can share a stall on the same market day | text conflict in canon.json, src/index.ts: a person resolves it by reading the code |
| agent-4 | A sold-out product cannot be added to the basket | merged cleanly |
| agent-1 | The basket charges the listed price, with 10% off any line of 10 or more | merged cleanly |

| Canon fact on the merged app | Result |
|---|---|
| The market page lists every stall | holds |
| All six products are for sale with a price | holds |
| A new shopper's basket is empty | holds |
| The basket charges the listed price for every unit | **broken**: sample 2, step 3: totalCents is 6430, expected 7000 (with qty1 = 19, item1 = kale, qty2 = 2, item2 = duck-eggs) |
| A product that does not exist cannot be added | holds |
| The market page answers in under 400 ms (p95 of 20 requests) | holds |
| The code type-checks, with no errors silenced | holds |
| The code passes the linter, with no rules silenced | holds |
| The toolchain, its settings and the deploy config only change by revision | holds |

| Fact an agent claimed | On the merged app |
|---|---|
| Buying 10 or more of one item takes 10% off that line | holds |
| A stall cannot be double-booked | holds |
| Shoppers can search products by name | holds |
| Two vendors can share a stall on the same market day | does not hold: step 2: POST /api/reservations returned 409, expected 201 |
| A sold-out product cannot be added to the basket | holds |
| The basket charges the listed price, with 10% off any line of 10 or more | holds |

Canon, on the same attempts: each was judged on its own live preview against every canon fact, so the ones that
broke a fact were rejected before anything merged, and clashing attempts were flagged before anyone accepted either.
